name: Warm cells, again
notes: N1110: the second wording of attention_sab_lamp, chosen per night by FS47Attention::SabScript (same beats and timing, other thoughts and trace text).

beats.text: The flashlight is nearly dead and the cell is warm. It should not drain that fast.
At {clock} the flashlight went dim all at once. The cells felt warm, as if they had been running for hours.
Two ceiling tubes went out with it. The Caliche shop counter has them in pairs.
